Package com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security

Class StepUpAuthorizationManager

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security.StepUpAuthorizationManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationManager<org.springframework.security.web.access.intercept.RequestAuthorizationContext>
public class StepUpAuthorizationManager extends Object implements org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationManager<org.springframework.security.web.access.intercept.RequestAuthorizationContext>
Requires that the bearer token proves a recent strong authentication (RFC 9470): its acr claim must be one of the configured (space-separated) values and its auth_time claim no older than the configured maximum age. The claims are read from the token attributes, so it serves JWTs (their claims) and opaque tokens (the introspection answer) alike.

A caller without the requiredAuthority is denied with an ordinary decision (answered 403 insufficient_scope); a caller that has it but fails the step-up check is denied with a StepUpRequiredDecision, which StepUpAccessDeniedHandler answers with the RFC 9470 challenge.

    • isAccepted

      private boolean isAccepted(Object acr)
      Tells whether an acr value is one of the configured ones. The configured acr-values is a space-separated list, like the acr_values parameter of OpenID Connect, so the token's single value must be a member of it, never equal to the whole list.
      Parameters:
      acr - the acr claim of the token.
      Returns:
      true when the claim is a text listed in the configured values.
